theme_strategy.public_site: Electric & Neon Archetype (Dark mode only). Deep dark backgrounds, glossy textures, glowing neon accents to match casino/betting aesthetics.
theme_strategy.admin_backoffice: Swiss & High-Contrast (Dark mode preferred). Professional, minimal, data-dense, authoritative.

typography.notes: Use Outfit for high-impact, bold headers and Manrope for legible body text. Import via Google Fonts.

public_site.surfaces: Glassmorphism for floating headers (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60). Cards use 'Tracing Beam' or glowing border on hover.
public_site.shadows: Intense neon drop-shadows on hover for active sponsor cards.

admin_backoffice.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton. Subtle 1px borders for tables and layout containers.
admin_backoffice.shadows: Minimal. Rely on 1px borders and background contrast for depth.

grids_and_layouts.public_site: Responsive 'Bento' or CSS Grid for Sponsor cards. grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 or up to 6 as per admin config. gap-4 to gap-6. Generous padding p-4.
grids_and_layouts.admin_backoffice: High Density Grid. Sidebar navigation + Main content area. Table structures for site and link management.

components.public_sponsor_card: A rounded-xl or rounded-2xl div, solid dark surface, hover:translate-y-[-4px] hover:shadow-[0_0_15px_var(--primary-accent)]. Contains logo (center) + offer text (bottom).
components.admin_forms: Shadcn UI Input, Switch, Select, Tabs. Heavily customized to fit the sleek dark theme.
components.admin_tables: Cardless, dense data tables. border-collapse with subtle border-b for rows.

motion.hover_states: Sponsor cards MUST scale up (scale-105) and emit a box-shadow glow. Buttons should have a slight brightness increase.
motion.page_transitions: Framer motion for subtle fade-in of the grid items (staggered).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast on all text over dark backgrounds. Offer text on cards must be high contrast.
accessibility.focus_states: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:outline-none for all interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='sponsor-card-1', data-testid='admin-login-btn').

background_textures.description: Dark abstract glowing background for public site header or overall body bg.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use .tsx, all components must be .js or .jsx.
Implement a unified backoffice that allows dynamic editing of the public site's layout (column count, colors, background).
Public site MUST default to a dark, glossy casino/betting aesthetic. Use neon accents (yellows, greens) and dark gradients for depth.
Avoid standard Shadcn 'Card' wrappers for the public site grids, build custom responsive <div> elements to achieve the glowing glassmorphism effect.
Ensure 'data-testid' attributes are attached to all key interaction points (e.g., login forms, save buttons, sponsor links).
Do not use complete transparent backgrounds for headers; apply backdrop-blur and a semi-transparent dark fill.
Use Phosphor icons or lucide-react for iconography.
DO NOT output placeholder URLs for images, use the provided Unsplash URLs.
Create deep visual hierarchy using layered z-index, glowing borders, and drop shadows on the public site.
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Push boundaries with asymmetry and bold spacing.
Never apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition-transform` or `transition-colors`.
Do not center-align body text or app containers; preserve natural left-aligned reading flows.
Ensure dark themes do not rely on 100% black (#000) or 100% white (#fff). Tint neutrals slightly for richness.
